lessons.title: Introduction to Python
lessons.description: Understand what Python is, why it is one of the most popular programming languages, and write your first Python program.

lessons.title: Variables and Data Types
lessons.description: Learn how to store information using variables and explore Python's core data types including strings, integers, floats, and booleans.

lessons.title: Control Flow and Loops
lessons.description: Control how your program runs using if statements, for loops, and while loops to build logic and repeat actions.
